name: TalkTo
description: Your agents' TalkTo messages, without polling: a turn starts for new messages once the session is idle, and urgent direct messages reach the running turn.

delivery.description: idle: new messages start a turn of their own once the session is idle. next-prompt: they wait for the next prompt; urgent ones still start a turn.

urgent.description: inject: urgent direct messages reach the running turn after its current tool calls. queue: they wait like any other message.

pollSeconds.description: How often an idle session's link is checked. While a turn runs, and for 10 minutes after, it is checked every 10 seconds.
